reviews.text: This place is a SCAM! Do NOT take your pets here. They’ll gladly charge you $1,000 and do nothing to help your pet then want to charge you another $600 for an ultrasound. I will never bring my pets here again!! Thank you for killing my pet and lot helping

Dr Pan is very knowledge and great with both the doggos and the doggos parents. The vet techs are super friendly. It's the 1st vet in a long time my diva dog has been comfortable at and not completely turning inside out in fear. Very professional.
Amazing people and my dog absolutely loves them.
Do not like the constant pushing of every treatment under the sun at each visit

I’ve been going here for years, and my pup could not be in better hands. Dr. Pan and the wonderful vet techs (big shout out) and staff, are excellent. Everyone I’ve interacted with are kind, knowledgeable, and clearly great at what they do. I highly recommend Desert View to anyone looking to get the best care for their pets.

All dog owners should see Dr Pan. The best vet.
Dr Pan and all the Staff are very friendly.
Very Highly Recommended!
Prices seem very high. I have to bring dog back for a booster and know they will charge me another office visit. That’s just wrong
Dr Pan took very good care of my two dogs
Great service, really caring staff. They worked my dog in even though the schedule was full. Thank you for taking such good care of my boy!
Amazing staff!! They are always friendly and actually care about my dog

Took my dog in right away for
X-rays
I love Desert View! We have been bringing our dogs here for years now. The staff is always friendly and Dr. Pan is great! Always honest and very knowledgeable!
A truly great team of caring people.

We love Dr Pan. She helped our previous dogs and cat live really long, happy lives including some dental issues with our 14 year old German Shepherd. We’re hoping to bring our current dog back for many more years.
All of the staff were so helpful and friendly, Bernard felt very at peace and calm when being checked by the techs and doctor which made me feel great.

We recently moved to Phoenix from the east coast and after doing ample research, decided to take our cat and dog to Desert View. Our first visit was today and I am thoroughly impressed - from walking in and speaking to the delightful front desk staff to the vet tech and to Dr. Pan, the experience was 10/10. The environment was welcoming and calm. They were extremely caring of my cat and thorough in his evaluation. I’m so happy to know we’ve found our go-to “family vet” on the first try!

We established here for our dog who suffers from anxiety. She takes an SSRI (which was started by the vet here). We are moving across the country in a week, have a newborn at home, yet they will not give us a bridge refill since we are a month overdue for an annual visit. SSRIs cannot be abruptly stopped and can cause our dog to have harmful withdrawal symptoms. This is absolutely cruel. I do not recommend bringing your pet here as they clearly care more about nickel and diming their patients rather than looking out for a family and their pet’s best interest.

Follow up: Dr Pan just called me herself and reprimanded me for not bringining in our pet because she is "a month" overdue despite again our excruciating circumstances. She talked overme and raised her voice consistently. Do not give this place your business unless you are okay with being treated like a toddler and your pet suffer the consequences.
